name: The Ritz-Carlton Shanghai, Pudong
positioning: Art Deco-inspired hotel on the upper floors of a 58-floor tower in Lujiazui, Shanghai, with a rooftop bar, a Club Lounge and a spa
best_for: Travelers who want a high-floor Art Deco hotel in the Lujiazui financial district
Families who like in-room kids programs such as the Ritz Kids Night Safari

facts.text: The hotel sits on the upper levels of a 58-floor tower in Lujiazui, Shanghai's commercial, financial and upscale retail district.
The hotel's design merges Art Deco elegance with contemporary design.
Rooms and suites overlook the Shanghai skyline and have Art Deco accents.
Jin Xuan was designed by Hong Kong interior designer and architect Steven Leung.
Aura Lounge serves tea, coffee, light fare and Afternoon Tea, followed by live music and handcrafted cocktails.
The spa is on the 55th floor and has a dry sauna, steam room and heated indoor pool.
The Club Lounge offers five complimentary food and beverage presentations each day.
The hotel is surrounded by Fortune 500 company offices, the Shanghai New International Expo Centre and attractions such as the Shanghai Ocean Aquarium.
Condé Nast Traveler says the hotel fills the top floors of a 58-story financial district building, a quick walk from the Oriental Pearl Tower.

highlights.text: Flair is a rooftop restaurant and bar on the 58th floor, in the center of Lujiazui.
The Ritz-Carlton Club Lounge is on level 49 and has floor-to-ceiling windows with views of the Bund and Huangpu River.
Jin Xuan Chinese Restaurant serves Cantonese cuisine and regional Chinese favorites, on the 53rd floor.
Ritz Kids Night Safari lets children set up camp in a tent in the guest room.
The Club Lounge holds a weekly Caviar and Champagne night every Friday.

considerations.text: Club access requires an upgraded booking; Marriott Bonvoy Elite Status does not provide complimentary Club access.
The hotel does not provide a shuttle service.
Pets are not allowed at the hotel.
